verses.text: It is better to eat a dry crust of bread in peace than to have a house full of feasting with fighting.
A wise servant will rule over a master's son who brings shame, and will share the inheritance with the brothers.
A melting pot tests silver, and a furnace tests gold, but the LORD tests hearts.
Evil people listen to evil talk. Liars pay attention to harmful words.
Whoever makes fun of the poor insults their Maker. Whoever is happy when disaster strikes will be punished.
Grandchildren are a crown to the old, and parents are the pride of their children.
Fine words do not suit a fool, and lying words suit a ruler even less.
A bribe seems like a magic stone to the one who gives it. Wherever he turns, he thinks he will succeed.
Whoever forgives an offence builds love, but whoever keeps bringing it up separates close friends.
One warning goes deeper into a person with understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
Evil people are always looking to rebel, so a cruel messenger will be sent against them.
It is better to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than a fool doing something foolish.
If someone pays back evil for good, trouble will never leave their house.
Starting a fight is like letting water out of a dam, so stop before the argument breaks out.
Declaring the guilty innocent and the innocent guilty are both hated by the LORD.
Why should a fool have money to pay for wisdom when he has no desire to understand?
A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born to help in times of trouble.
Only someone with no sense would shake hands to guarantee a neighbour's debt.
Whoever loves to sin loves to fight. Whoever builds a high gate is asking for disaster.
People with twisted hearts do not do well, and people who tell lies fall into trouble.
Having a foolish child brings sorrow. The father of a fool has no joy.
A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
Wicked people secretly accept bribes to twist justice.
A person with understanding keeps their eyes on wisdom, but a fool's eyes wander to the ends of the earth.
A foolish son brings sorrow to his father and bitterness to his mother.
It is not good to punish innocent people, or to beat officials for being honest.
People with knowledge are careful with their words. People with understanding stay calm.
Even fools are thought to be wise if they keep quiet. If they keep their mouths shut, they seem to have understanding.
